flags.help: ranges of CPUs for affinity. Complements --cpu-mask-batch

flags.name: --cpu-strict-batch
flags.help: use strict CPU placement

flags.name: --prio-batch
flags.help: set process/thread priority : 0-normal, 1-medium, 2-high, 3-realtime

flags.name: --poll-batch

flags.name: --predict
flags.help: number of tokens to predict

flags.name: --batch-size
flags.help: logical maximum batch size

flags.name: --ubatch-size
flags.help: physical maximum batch size

flags.name: --keep
flags.help: number of tokens to keep from the initial prompt

flags.name: --swa-full
flags.help: use full-size SWA cache [(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/13194#issuecomment-2868343055)

flags.name: --flash-attn
flags.help: set Flash Attention use ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto')

flags.name: --perf
flags.help: whether to enable internal libllama performance timings

flags.name: --escape
flags.help: whether to process escapes sequences (\n, \r, \t, \', \", \\)

flags.name: --rope-scaling
flags.help: RoPE frequency scaling method, defaults to linear unless specified by the model

flags.name: --rope-scale
flags.help: RoPE context scaling factor, expands context by a factor of N

flags.name: --rope-freq-base
flags.help: RoPE base frequency, used by NTK-aware scaling

flags.name: --rope-freq-scale
flags.help: RoPE frequency scaling factor, expands context by a factor of 1/N

flags.name: --yarn-orig-ctx
flags.help: YaRN: original context size of model

flags.name: --yarn-ext-factor
flags.help: YaRN: extrapolation mix factor

flags.name: --yarn-attn-factor
flags.help: YaRN: scale sqrt(t) or attention magnitude

flags.name: --yarn-beta-slow
flags.help: YaRN: high correction dim or alpha

flags.name: --yarn-beta-fast
flags.help: YaRN: low correction dim or beta

flags.name: --kv-offload
flags.help: whether to enable KV cache offloading

flags.name: --repack
flags.help: whether to enable weight repacking

flags.name: --no-host
flags.help: bypass host buffer allowing extra buffers to be used

flags.name: --cache-type-k
flags.help: KV cache data type for K allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1

flags.name: --cache-type-v
flags.help: KV cache data type for V allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1

flags.name: --defrag-thold
flags.help: KV cache defragmentation threshold (DEPRECATED)

flags.name: --rpc
flags.help: comma-separated list of RPC servers (host:port)

flags.name: --load-mode
flags.help: model loading mode - auto: mmap, unless a device does not support it - none: no special loading mode - mmap: memory-map model (if mmap disabled, slower load but may reduce pageouts if not using mlock) - mlock: force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing - mmap+mlock: mmap + force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing - dio: use DirectIO if available

flags.name: --lazy-mode
flags.help: on-demand reading of certain tensors, for example per-layer embeddings - on: read the rows of such tensors from disk on demand instead of keeping them resident (requires mmap) - auto: on, but only for tensors larger than 4 GiB - off: always keep them resident

flags.name: --numa
flags.help: attempt optimizations that help on some NUMA systems - distribute: spread execution evenly over all nodes - isolate: only spawn threads on CPUs on the node that execution started on - numactl: use the CPU map provided by numactl if run without this previously, it is recommended to drop the system page cache before using this see https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/1437

flags.name: --device
flags.help: comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading (none = don't offload) use --list-devices to see a list of available devices

flags.name: --list-devices
flags.help: print list of available devices and exit

flags.name: --override-tensor
flags.help: override tensor buffer type

flags.name: --cpu-moe
flags.help: keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU

flags.name: --n-cpu-moe
flags.help: keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU

flags.name: --n-cpu-ffn
flags.help: keep the dense FFN weights of the first N layers in the CPU (dense models; for MoE expert weights use --n-cpu-moe)

flags.name: --gpu-layers
flags.help: max. number of layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all'

flags.name: --split-mode
flags.help: how to split the model across multiple GPUs, one of: - none: use one GPU only - layer (default): split layers and KV across GPUs (pipelined) - row: split weight across GPUs by rows (parallelized) - tensor: split weights and KV across GPUs (parallelized, EXPERIMENTAL)

flags.name: --tensor-split
flags.help: fraction of the model to offload to each GPU, comma-separated list of proportions, e.g. 3,1

flags.name: --main-gpu
flags.help: the GPU to use for the model (with split-mode = none), or for intermediate results and KV (with split-mode = row)

flags.name: --fit
flags.help: whether to adjust unset arguments to fit in device memory ('on' or 'off', default: 'on')

flags.name: --fit-target
flags.help: target margin per device for --fit, comma-separated list of values, single value is broadcast across all devices, default: 1024

flags.name: --fit-ctx
flags.help: minimum ctx size that can be set by --fit option, default: 4096

flags.name: --check-tensors
flags.help: check model tensor data for invalid values

flags.name: --override-kv
flags.help: advanced option to override model metadata by key. to specify multiple overrides, either use comma-separated values. types: int, float, bool, str. example: --override-kv tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token=bool:false,tokenizer.ggml.add_eos_token=bool:false

flags.name: --op-offload
flags.help: whether to offload host tensor operations to device

flags.name: --lora
flags.help: path to LoRA adapter (use comma-separated values to load multiple adapters)

flags.name: --lora-scaled
flags.help: path to LoRA adapter with user defined scaling (format: FNAME:SCALE,...) note: use comma-separated values

flags.name: --control-vector
flags.help: add a control vector note: use comma-separated values to add multiple control vectors

flags.name: --control-vector-scaled
flags.help: add a control vector with user defined scaling SCALE note: use comma-separated values (format: FNAME:SCALE,...)

flags.name: --control-vector-layer-range
flags.help: layer range to apply the control vector(s) to, start and end inclusive

flags.name: --model
flags.help: model path to load

flags.name: --model-url
flags.help: model download url

flags.name: --docker-repo
flags.help: Docker Hub model repository. repo is optional, default to ai/. quant is optional, default to :latest. example: gemma3

flags.name: --hf-repo
flags.help: Hugging Face model repository; quant is optional, case-insensitive, default to Q4_K_M, or falls back to the first file in the repo if Q4_K_M doesn't exist. mmproj is also downloaded automatically if available. to disable, add --no-mmproj example: ggml-org/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF:Q4_K_M

flags.name: --hf-file
flags.help: Hugging Face model file. If specified, it will override the quant in --hf-repo

flags.name: --hf-token
flags.help: Hugging Face access token

flags.name: --log-disable
flags.help: Log disable

flags.name: --log-file
flags.help: Log to file

flags.name: --log-jsonl
flags.help: Log as JSONL (one JSON object per line) to stdout, this also disables colored logging

flags.name: --log-colors
flags.help: Set colored logging ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto') 'auto' enables colors when output is to a terminal

flags.name: --verbose
flags.help: Set verbosity level to infinity (i.e. log all messages, useful for debugging)

flags.name: --offline
flags.help: Offline mode: forces use of cache, prevents network access

flags.name: --verbosity
flags.help: Set the verbosity threshold. Messages with a higher verbosity will be ignored. Values: - 0: generic output - 1: error - 2: warning - 3: info - 4: trace (more info) - 5: debug

flags.name: --log-prefix
flags.help: Enable prefix in log messages

flags.name: --log-timestamps
flags.help: Enable timestamps in log messages

flags.name: --spec-draft-type-k
flags.help: KV cache data type for K for the draft model allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1

flags.name: --spec-draft-type-v
flags.help: KV cache data type for V for the draft model allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1

flags.name: --samplers
flags.help: samplers that will be used for generation in the order, separated by ';'

flags.name: --seed
flags.help: RNG seed

flags.name: --sampler-seq
flags.help: simplified sequence for samplers that will be used

flags.name: --ignore-eos
flags.help: ignore end of stream token and continue generating (implies --logit-bias EOS-inf)

flags.name: --temp
flags.help: temperature

flags.name: --top-k
flags.help: top-k sampling

flags.name: --top-p
flags.help: top-p sampling

flags.name: --min-p
flags.help: min-p sampling

flags.name: --top-nsigma
flags.help: top-n-sigma sampling

flags.name: --xtc-probability
flags.help: xtc probability

flags.name: --xtc-threshold
flags.help: xtc threshold

flags.name: --typical
flags.help: locally typical sampling, parameter p

flags.name: --repeat-last-n
flags.help: last n tokens to consider for penalize

flags.name: --repeat-penalty
flags.help: penalize repeat sequence of tokens

flags.name: --presence-penalty
flags.help: repeat alpha presence penalty

flags.name: --frequency-penalty
flags.help: repeat alpha frequency penalty

flags.name: --dry-multiplier
flags.help: set DRY sampling multiplier

flags.name: --dry-base
flags.help: set DRY sampling base value

flags.name: --dry-allowed-length
flags.help: set allowed length for DRY sampling

flags.name: --dry-penalty-last-n
flags.help: set DRY penalty for the last n tokens

flags.name: --dry-sequence-breaker
flags.help: add sequence breaker for DRY sampling, clearing out default breakers ('\n', ':', '"', '*') in the process; use "none" to not use any sequence breakers

flags.name: --adaptive-target
flags.help: adaptive-p: select tokens near this probability (valid range 0.0 to 1.0; negative = disabled) [(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/17927)

flags.name: --adaptive-decay
flags.help: adaptive-p: decay rate for target adaptation over time. lower values are more reactive, higher values are more stable. (valid range 0.0 to 0.99)

flags.name: --dynatemp-range
flags.help: dynamic temperature range

flags.name: --dynatemp-exp
flags.help: dynamic temperature exponent

flags.name: --mirostat
flags.help: use Mirostat sampling. Top K, Nucleus and Locally Typical samplers are ignored if used.

flags.name: --mirostat-lr
flags.help: Mirostat learning rate, parameter eta

flags.name: --mirostat-ent
flags.help: Mirostat target entropy, parameter tau

flags.name: --logit-bias
flags.help: modifies the likelihood of token appearing in the completion, i.e. `--logit-bias 15043+1` to increase likelihood of token ' Hello', or `--logit-bias 15043-1` to decrease likelihood of token ' Hello'

flags.name: --grammar
flags.help: BNF-like grammar to constrain generations (see samples in grammars/ dir)

flags.name: --grammar-file
flags.help: file to read grammar from

flags.name: --json-schema
flags.help: JSON schema to constrain generations (https://json-schema.org/), e.g. `{"type": "object"}` for any JSON object

flags.name: --json-schema-file
flags.help: File containing a JSON schema to constrain generations (https://json-schema.org/), e.g. `{"type": "object"}` for any JSON object

flags.name: --backend-sampling
flags.help: enable backend sampling (experimental)

flags.name: --lookup-cache-static
flags.help: path to static lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (not updated by generation)

flags.name: --lookup-cache-dynamic
flags.help: path to dynamic lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (updated by generation)

flags.name: --kv-unified-per-slot
flags.help: context limit per parallel slot . when set without -c/--ctx-size, the shared KV pool is sized to n_parallel*N

flags.name: --ctx-checkpoints
flags.help: max number of context checkpoints to create per slot [(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/15293)

flags.name: --checkpoint-min-step
flags.help: minimum spacing between context checkpoints in tokens

flags.name: --cache-ram
flags.help: set the maximum cache size in MiB [(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/16391)

flags.name: --kv-unified
flags.default: enabled if number of slots is auto
flags.help: use single unified KV buffer shared across all sequences

flags.name: --cache-idle-slots
flags.help: save idle slots to the prompt cache on new task, and clear them when using unified KV

flags.name: --context-shift
flags.help: whether to use context shift on infinite text generation

flags.name: --reverse-prompt
flags.help: halt generation at PROMPT, return control in interactive mode

flags.name: --special
flags.help: special tokens output enabled

flags.name: --warmup
flags.help: whether to perform warmup with an empty run

flags.name: --spm-infill
flags.help: use Suffix/Prefix/Middle pattern for infill (instead of Prefix/Suffix/Middle) as some models prefer this.

flags.name: --pooling
flags.help: pooling type for embeddings, use model default if unspecified

flags.name: --parallel
flags.help: number of server slots

flags.name: --cont-batching
flags.help: whether to enable continuous batching (a.k.a dynamic batching)

flags.name: --mmproj
flags.help: path to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md note: if -hf is used, this argument can be omitted

flags.name: --mmproj-url
flags.help: URL to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md

flags.name: --mmproj-auto
flags.help: whether to use multimodal projector file (if available), useful when using -hf

flags.name: --mmproj-offload
flags.help: whether to enable GPU offloading for multimodal projector

flags.name: --mmproj-device
flags.help: device to use for multimodal projector (none = don't offload, default: follows --device) use --list-devices to see a list of available devices

flags.name: --image-min-tokens
flags.help: minimum number of tokens each image can take, only used by vision models with dynamic resolution

flags.name: --image-max-tokens
flags.help: maximum number of tokens each image can take, only used by vision models with dynamic resolution

flags.name: --mtmd-batch-max-tokens
flags.help: maximum number of image tokens per batch when encoding images

flags.name: --video-fps
flags.help: target video frame rate

flags.name: --video-timestamp-interval
flags.help: interval in milliseconds between text timestamps

flags.name: --video-ffmpeg-dir
flags.help: path to the directory containing ffmpeg and ffprobe

flags.name: --alias
flags.help: set model name aliases, comma-separated (to be used by API)

flags.name: --tags
flags.help: set model tags, comma-separated (informational, not used for routing)

flags.name: --embd-normalize
flags.help: normalisation for embeddings (-1=none, 0=max absolute int16, 1=taxicab, 2=euclidean, >2=p-norm)

flags.name: --host
flags.help: IP addresses to listen on, comma-separated, or UNIX socket paths ending in .sock; with multiple TCP addresses, :: binds IPv6 only; overlapping addresses result in undefined behavior

flags.name: --port
flags.help: port to listen

flags.name: --reuse-port
flags.help: allow multiple sockets to bind to the same port

flags.name: --path
flags.help: path to serve static files from

flags.name: --cors-origins
flags.help: comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS if set to special value 'localhost', reflect the Origin header only if it is localhost

flags.name: --cors-methods
flags.help: comma-separated list of allowed methods for CORS

flags.name: --cors-headers
flags.help: comma-separated list of allowed headers for CORS

flags.name: --cors-credentials
flags.help: whether to allow credentials for CORS note: if this is enabled and --cors-origins is set to * (default), the Origin header will be echoed back, and credentials will always be allowed

flags.name: --api-prefix
flags.help: prefix path the server serves from, without the trailing slash

flags.name: --ui-config
flags.help: JSON that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)

flags.name: --ui-config-file
flags.help: JSON file that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)

flags.name: --ui-mcp-proxy
flags.help: experimental: whether to enable MCP CORS proxy - do not enable in untrusted environments

flags.name: --tools
flags.help: experimental: whether to enable built-in tools for AI agents - do not enable in untrusted environments specify "all" to enable all tools available tools: read_file, file_glob_search, grep_search, exec_shell_command, write_file, edit_file, get_info note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

flags.name: --tools-runtime
flags.help: experimental: run tools in a separate runtime environment available options: 'docker:<image>', 'podman:<image>': spin up a new container and reuse it for all invocations, clean up on server exit 'docker-container:<id>', 'podman-container:<id>': use an existing container by ID, won't stop on server exit 'ssh:<target>': run tools on a remote POSIX host over SSH, key-based auth and a trusted host key are required

flags.name: --mcp-servers-config
flags.help: experimental: path to JSON file with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

flags.name: --mcp-servers-json
flags.help: experimental: inline JSON with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

flags.name: --agent
flags.help: whether to enable CORS proxy and all built-in tools - do not enable in untrusted environments note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

flags.name: --ui
flags.help: whether to enable the Web UI

flags.name: --embedding
flags.help: restrict to only support embedding use case; use only with dedicated embedding models

flags.name: --rerank
flags.help: enable reranking endpoint on server

flags.name: --api-key
flags.help: API key to use for authentication, multiple keys can be provided as a comma-separated list

flags.name: --api-key-file
flags.help: path to file containing API keys, one per line; lines starting with a hash are treated as comments

flags.name: --ssl-key-file
flags.help: path to file a PEM-encoded SSL private key

flags.name: --ssl-cert-file
flags.help: path to file a PEM-encoded SSL certificate

flags.name: --chat-template-kwargs
flags.help: sets additional params for the json template parser, must be a valid json object string, e.g. '{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}'

flags.name: --timeout
flags.help: server read/write timeout in seconds

flags.name: --sse-ping-interval
flags.help: server SSE ping interval in seconds (-1 = disabled, default: 30)

flags.name: --threads-http
flags.help: number of threads used to process HTTP requests

flags.name: --cache-prompt
flags.help: whether to enable prompt caching

flags.name: --cache-reuse
flags.help: min chunk size to attempt reusing from the cache via KV shifting, requires prompt caching to be enabled [(card)](https://ggml.ai/f0.png)

flags.name: --metrics
flags.help: enable prometheus compatible metrics endpoint

flags.name: --props
flags.help: enable changing global properties via POST /props

flags.name: --slots
flags.help: expose slots monitoring endpoint

flags.name: --slot-save-path
flags.help: path to save slot kv cache

flags.name: --media-path
flags.help: directory for loading local media files; files can be accessed via file:// URLs using relative paths

flags.name: --models-dir
flags.help: directory containing models for the router server

flags.name: --models-preset
flags.help: path to INI file containing model presets for the router server

flags.name: --models-max
flags.help: for router server, maximum number of models to load simultaneously

flags.name: --models-autoload
flags.help: for router server, whether to automatically load models

flags.name: --jinja
flags.help: whether to use jinja template engine for chat

flags.name: --reasoning-format
flags.help: controls whether thought tags are allowed and/or extracted from the response, and in which format they're returned; one of: - none: leaves thoughts unparsed in `message.content` - deepseek: puts thoughts in `message.reasoning_content` - deepseek-legacy: keeps `<think>` tags in `message.content` while also populating `message.reasoning_content`

flags.name: --reasoning
flags.help: Use reasoning/thinking in the chat ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto' (detect from template))

flags.name: --reasoning-effort
flags.help: reasoning effort level given to the chat template: 'default' to keep the template default, or a level such as 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh' or 'max'
